<!-- Add the 2026 survey URL to survey_url above, then knit this file.
     Both the clickable link and QR code are generated from that same URL.
     Leave it empty to render a draft with no outdated link or QR code. -->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
survey_url <- trimws(params$survey_url)
stopifnot(is.character(survey_url), length(survey_url) == 1L, !is.na(survey_url))
if (nzchar(survey_url) && !grepl("^https?://[^[:space:]]+$", survey_url)) {
  stop("survey_url must be a complete http:// or https:// URL.")
}
```

## Your feedback matters!

Taking a few minutes to complete your *MySay* survey really helps us understand how the module is working for you. Your comments guide us in improving the course -- whether that means changing something that isn’t working or keeping what supports your learning best.

We genuinely want to hear from you -- what's working well and what we can do better. If only a few people respond, we might not get an accurate picture of how the class feels -- your voice helps make sure everyone's experience is represented.

Even if you don't have detailed comments, please still complete the MySay form -- every response counts. A higher response rate means the results better reflect the whole class experience.

We want to make this module as effective as possible for your learning. Your feedback helps us decide what to improve for future cohorts and what to keep.

It only takes a few minutes, but it really makes a difference.

**All feedback is:**

- **Anonymous** -- we can't trace individual responses.
- **Valued** -- we genuinely read and consider every comment.
- **Used** -- we act on feedback to make real improvements to teaching and learning.

```{r survey-link, results='asis'}
if (nzchar(survey_url)) {
  safe_url <- htmltools::htmlEscape(survey_url, attribute = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf('<p>Please <a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">complete the MySay survey</a> or scan the QR code below.</p>\n', safe_url))
} else {
  cat('<p><strong>2026 survey link to be added.</strong> The survey link and QR code will appear here once the new link is available.</p>\n')
}
```

```{r survey-qr, eval=nzchar(survey_url), fig.width=4, fig.height=4, out.width='300px', fig.align='center', fig.alt='QR code linking to this module’s 2026 MySay survey', dev='png', dpi=150}
qr <- qrcode::qr_code(survey_url, ecl = "M")
# A four-module white margin helps phone cameras recognise the QR code.
quiet_qr <- matrix(FALSE, nrow(qr) + 8L, ncol(qr) + 8L)
quiet_qr[seq_len(nrow(qr)) + 4L, seq_len(ncol(qr)) + 4L] <- qr
class(quiet_qr) <- class(qr)
plot(quiet_qr)
```
